featured_reviews.review_text:
I had spent almost 1.4L for 4 geyser which I couldn't even use for 30 days properly

The company just wants to sell and earn profit with no proper after sales service.

As mentioned below by autobright steel industries. Purchased the product Valliant VED 18-24Kw geyser (4pc) while renovating my home. Near to 1 year passed as my house got renovated summer came so dint feel like to use geyser. As soon as Rainny season came we started using geyser and found that they are completely dead.

After multiple follow up also they got 1 PC repaired by company end in which they changed the PCB for others 3 PC they were asking for 11200/- per PC so I waited for few days to check if it working properly or not. Later after 10-15days passed the machine again got dead in working condition. When asked for reason they say light fluctuations where as other all machine working at home are completely fine and functioning.

Later I had bought 2 PC of stiebel geyser which are working absolutely fine in the same electric power provided to Valliant geysers.

There is no person in the company to take responsibility of the geyser.

Later I had to ask local pcb repair person to check the issue. Where he found basic issue about transformer provided inside the machine is of 400V only where as in india 415-440V which comes. So how would the transformer take load ?

Still we are waiting for the pcb repair person to get it fixed 100%.

So recommend all not to purchase such failure product with no proper technical fit pcb inside.

Hope company director and top management take proper responsibility and provide solutions to customers rather just focusing on sales and earning profit.
